sonnet.problem: The right answer, Cyrus, is already named on card 1 as the king who authorized the work, so earlier setup points straight at it.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The question says Jerusalem 'has always been trouble.' That gives away the answer to card 12 (it revolted against kings long ago) and rules out the wrong answers 'had always lived in peace' and 'had never been ruled by kings.'
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
